# `bash`

> Profile: core · Permission key: `[permission] bash` · Aliases: `shell`

Run a shell command. Long notes: `read agent://tools/bash`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `background` | boolean | no | If true, start the command in the background and return a job id immediately |
| `command` | string | yes | The shell command to execute |
| `description` | string | no | Short description of why this command is run (optional) |
| `timeout` | integer | no | Timeout in seconds (default: 120; ignored when background=true) |

## Guide

The model reads this with `read agent://tools/bash`.

Execute a shell command in the project environment.

Default: wait for stdout/stderr (timeout 120s).
`background=true` returns a job id immediately; use `bg` to list/read/kill.
Long-running non-catastrophic commands auto-detach after 20s unless
`[tools.bash] auto_background = false`. Catastrophic commands (rm -rf /,
git clean of home, …) stay in the foreground and still hit the permission gate.
Child processes do not inherit provider API keys. Detached output lives under
`.whycodes/scratch`, not the OS temp dir.
